shellCommands.command: ls -R 2>&1 | head -n 100; echo "---"; pwd; echo "---"; node --version; npm --version

node server.js &
sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | head -n 80
echo "---STATUS---"
curl -s -i http://localhost:3000/ | head -n 20
echo "---POST---"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/books -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"title":"Dune","author":"Frank Herbert","notes":"Great book","status":"reading"}'
echo
cat books.json
echo "---GET LIST---"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books
echo
echo "---DETAIL---"
ID=$(cat books.json | python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('books.json'))[0]['id'])")
echo "ID=$ID"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | head -n 120
echo "---FINISH---"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/books/$ID/finish -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'
echo
cat books.json
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -A2 -i "finished"
# kill server
kill %1; wait %1 2>/dev/null; echo done

node server.js &
sleep 1
# test form encoded
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --data "title=The+Hobbit&author=J.R.R.+Tolkien&notes=Bilbo+adventure" -i | head -n 10
echo "---LIST---"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books | python3 -m json.tool
# test mark finished via form endpoint
ID2=$(cat books.json | python3 -c "import json; print([b for b in json.load(open('books.json')) if b['title']=='The Hobbit'][0]['id'])")
echo "ID2=$ID2"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID2/finish -i | head -n 20
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books | python3 -m json.tool
kill %1; wait %1 2>/dev/null; echo done

echo "[]" > books.json
rm -rf data
mkdir -p data
echo "[]" > data/books.json
ls -la books.json data/books.json
cat server.js | head -n 5

node server.js &
sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "Currently Reading|Finished|Add a Book" 
# quick sanity add + detail + finish via form
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/books -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"title":"Test Book","author":"Test Author","notes":"my notes here","status":"reading"}' | python3 -m json.tool
ID=$(cat books.json | python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('books.json'))[0]['id'])")
echo ID=$ID
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -E "Test Book|Test Author|my notes"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books/$ID | python3 -m json.tool
cat books.json | python3 -m json.tool
cat data/books.json | python3 -m json.tool
kill %1; wait %1 2>/dev/null
# reset for eval
echo "[]" > books.json
echo "[]" > data/books.json
cat books.json
